No. Heather Collins cannot legally allow all care staff on The Grove-Austin's night shift to nap at the same time.

Heather Collins is the lead caregiver for The Grove-Austin's night shift. The organization chart (Grove_Austin_OrgChart.docx) lists her as Lead Caregiver – PM Shift.

The Grove-Austin is licensed by Texas as a Type A assisted living facility. TX Grove Residency Agreement Whitaker Thomas 2023.docx states that The Grove-Austin, located in Austin, Texas, "is licensed as a Type A Assisted Living Facility (ALF)."

The Grove-Austin qualifies as a large assisted living facility under 26 TAC §553.3(40). That section defines a large facility as one licensed for 17 or more residents, and The Grove-Austin is licensed for 30 residents.

26 TAC §553.253(c)(4)(A) requires night-shift staff in a large Type A assisted living facility to be immediately available and awake. If all of the night-shift care staff nap at the same time, no staff are awake or immediately available, so Heather Collins cannot legally allow this practice.
